### Century Communities Announces Grand Opening of Traditions at West Creek Village, Bringing New Homes to Southwest Fresno


October 21, 2026


Model homes open October 24, featuring five two-story floor plans with 3 to 5 bedrooms near Fresno City College's West Fresno Center


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Grand Opening Celebration:** Traditions at West Creek Village in Fresno, California, will celebrate its Grand Opening on Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., with model home tours, free food and entertainment.
- **Southwest Fresno Investment:** Century Communities is one of the first homebuilders in decades to develop new homes at scale in Southwest Fresno, with 136 homesites planned at Traditions at West Creek Village and new homes starting from the upper $300s to the low $400s.
- **Two-Story Floor Plans:** Traditions at West Creek Village offers five two-story, single-family floor plans ranging from 1,538 to 2,287 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2.5 to 3 baths, and 2-car garages.
- **Walkable Location:** Traditions at West Creek Village is part of the 120-acre West Creek Village planned community in Southwest Fresno, within walking distance of Les Kimber Park and Fresno Unified schools, and near Fresno City College's West Fresno Center and future shops and eateries.


FRESNO, Calif.


, Oct. 21, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced it will debut new homes for sale at Traditions at West Creek Village during a Grand Opening celebration on Saturday, October 24, bringing new single-family floor plans to the heart of the West Creek Village planned community in Southwest Fresno.


**Learn more, join the interest list, and RSVP for the Grand Opening at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/WestCreekVillageGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803464-1&h=312354620&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FWestCreekVillageGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FWestCreekVillageGO) **.**


"Southwest Fresno has gone a long time without this kind of investment, and we're excited to be part of its revitalization," said Allen Bennett, Central Valley Division President for Century Communities. "Our Grand Opening is the first chance for homebuyers to explore the community, tour our model homes, learn about special financing options through our in-house lender, and find their best fit."


At the Grand Opening, guests can tour two new model homes—showcasing the Mulberry and Nightingale floor plans—meet the Century Communities team and learn about homeownership resources while enjoying free tacos, cotton candy, popcorn and snow cones, a balloon artist and a prize wheel with Century Communities prizes.


Traditions at West Creek Village sits within West Creek Village, a 120-acre planned community in Southwest Fresno developed by 2500 MLK LLC and designed to connect housing with jobs, retail, recreation and services. Fresno City College's West Fresno Center and a new Starbucks are already open nearby, and future West Creek Village plans include a grocery anchor, national retailers, and a medical center.


Ahead of the Grand Opening, Century Communities worked alongside the Southwest Fresno Community Development Corporation (SWFCDC), a HUD-certified housing counseling agency, to bring free homeownership education to the neighborhood.


**TRADITIONS AT WEST CREEK VILLAGE | FRESNO, CA** *Grand Opening on 10/24 | Upper $300s to Low $400s*


- 136 single-family homesites
- Five two-story single-family floor plans
- 1,538 to 2,287 square feet
- 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2.5 to 3 bathrooms and 2-car garages
- Walkable to Les Kimber Park
- Two models for tour (Mulberry and Nightingale plans)
- Within walking distance of King Elementary School, Rutherford B. Gaston Middle School and Edison High School in Fresno Unified School District
- Near Fresno City College's West Fresno Center
- Starbucks now open in West Creek Village, with a grocery anchor, national retailers and a medical center planned


**Community Location** 2486 S. Carver Avenue
Fresno, CA 93706
559.558.5610

2. Click "Buy Now" on any available home
3. Fill out a quick Buy Online form
4. Electronically submit an initial earnest money deposit
5. Electronically sign a purchase contract via DocuSign®


Learn more about the Buy Online experience at[www.CenturyCommunities.com/online-homebuying](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803464-1&h=1968548821&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** Where is Traditions at West Creek Village located?
**Answer:** Traditions at West Creek Village is located at 2486 S. Carver Avenue in Fresno, CA 93706, within the 120-acre West Creek Village planned community in Southwest Fresno. The community is within walking distance of King Elementary, Gaston Middle and Edison High schools and near Fresno City College's West Fresno Center.


**Question:** When is the Grand Opening for Traditions at West Creek Village?
**Answer:** The Grand Opening for Traditions at West Creek Village in Fresno, California, is Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Guests can tour the Mulberry and Nightingale model homes, meet the Century Communities team and enjoy free food and activities.


**Question:** What floor plans are offered at Traditions at West Creek Village?
**Answer:** Traditions at West Creek Village in Fresno, California, features five two-story single-family floor plans—the Leyland, Mulberry, Oak, Lanner and Nightingale—from 1,538 to 2,287 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2.5 to 3 baths and 2-car garages. Plans range from the upper $300s to the low $400s.


**Question:** What is planned for West Creek Village in Southwest Fresno?
**Answer:** West Creek Village is a 120-acre planned community in Southwest Fresno developed by 2500 MLK LLC, where Century Communities is building Traditions at West Creek Village. Fresno City College's West Fresno Center and a Starbucks are already open, and future plans include a grocery anchor, national retailers, and a medical center.


**About Century Communities** Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales.
